question: In Linear: Rename the private team whose key starts with GR and whose description mentions the Q3 OKR pilot rollout to 'Growth Pod'.
final:

One thing to flag: my first rename attempt accidentally hit the Engineering team instead (the API response echoed the wrong team object, which I caught on verification). I reverted Engineering to its original name and confirmed the final state — all six teams are now correct, with GRW as the only team renamed.
